تستغبون (form X)
# تَسْتَغْبُونَ (tastaḡbūna) /tas.taɣ.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَغْبَى (istaḡbā)
# تُسْتَغْبَوْنَ (tustaḡbawna) /tus.taɣ.baw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَغْبَى (istaḡbā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
